Blue SquaresLimited Edition Framed Print by Gavin Moore We’re proud to present Blue Squares — a limited edition canvas print by Bayley Arts artist Gavin Moore. Framed in a beautiful floating oak frame, this striking piece is part of a new initiative to support our artists through high-quality reproductions of their work. Gavin will earn a commission from every sale. Print Details:– Limited edition of 12 only– 60cm x 60cm– Printed on 12oz 340gsm cotton canvas– Framed in a natural oak floating frame This is the first of what we hope will be many limited edition releases from our Bayley Arts community. We’re grateful to Fantastic Frames for making this pilot project possible. Please note:Each piece is printed to order. All sales are final. You’ll be notified when your order is ready to collect from Bayley Arts — typically within 14 days.
